t: You're at the site of the Old Den, the fifth home ground of Millwall Football Club, on Cold Blow Lane in New Cross. The club began on the Isle of Dogs in 1885, and this ground opened in 1910. Millwall played here for 83 years, until they moved to the New Den in May 1993. The record crowd was 48,672. It was designed by Archibald Leitch, the Scottish architect best known for his football stadiums across Britain and Ireland.
